# NORM & Radiation Safety Training

> NORM & Radiation Safety Training: 2 self-paced online courses from $47.99. 100% online, certificate on completion, team pricing.

Self-paced online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com), part of Industrial Certified Training, LLC (https://ictraining.us/). Courses are 100% online and work on any device, with a certificate of completion as soon as the final exam is passed. Team pricing applies from 2 to 1,000 seats. Phone: 1-866-429-6742.

## Courses

- [Radiofrequency (RF) Safety and Hazard Awareness Training](https://radiation-safety.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-466): $47.99 per person, 1 hour, English, certificate valid 36 months. Enroll: https://radiation-safety.onlinetrainingcourses.us/checkout?course=466. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/radiofrequency-rf-safety-and-hazard-awareness-training
- [NORM Worker Safety Training](https://radiation-safety.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-576): $179.99 per person, 8 hours, English, certificate valid 12 months. In accordance with IAEA GSR Part 3 and IAEA Safety Guide GSG-7, and Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910.1096. Enroll: https://radiation-safety.onlinetrainingcourses.us/checkout?course=576. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/norm-worker-safety-training
